name: 16-flask-explain-loader-loop
title: Tidy the explained template loading loop
body: Small cleanup of DispatchingJinjaLoader._get_source_explained: move the found-template bookkeeping into a try/else block and simplify the type annotation.

bugs.why: trv is overwritten by every later loader that finds the template, so with EXPLAIN_TEMPLATE_LOADING a blueprint template wins over the app's, unlike the fast path which returns the first match.
